HediffDef.label: revealed synthetic infiltrator
HediffDef.description: This exact pawn was operating under a human biological cover identity. The concealed nanite lattice has been permanently exposed; the pawn remains the same individual and faction member.

HediffDef.label: nanite lattice
HediffDef.description: The pawn's human form is maintained by a coordinated microscopic nanite lattice. The lattice reconstructs ordinary injuries by consuming Nanite Reserve and can be temporarily disrupted by EMP.

HediffDef.label: nanite depletion
HediffDef.description: The nanite body has too little stored matter to maintain full function. Continued depletion progressively reduces coordination until the body enters near-shutdown.

HediffDef.label: EMP-disrupted nanites
HediffDef.description: An electromagnetic pulse has disrupted coordination across the pawn's nanite lattice. Movement, manipulation and awareness remain impaired until the lattice resynchronizes; self-repair is suspended.
